task_message:
Case N16: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 261x261x241 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. I segmented the peripheral nerve sheath tumor (a well-circumscribed, lobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense mass in the limb musculature) using a single positive point prompt, then verified and corrected the result:

- Confirmed the lesion location and extent on axial, coronal and sagittal sheets (axial 133–208, coronal 88–143, sagittal 120–182).
- Checked the mask boundary and the slices just past each end in all three planes; no lesion tissue was left out.
- Evaluated the automatic candidates: rejected C1 (a thin rim/fascial leak along the posterior fascia) and C2/C3 (separate, non-contiguous bright structures inferior to the tumor, likely vessels/nerve plane).

Final mask: one component, 105.7 mL, saved with medium confidence.
